## ④ Notes

- **Carried from the predecessor (body revision of 2026-10-09T00:33Z):** REST `PUT /pulls/N/update-branch` from a cloud seat writes as the session's linked user, so base merges go to the PR's own dev (`git merge` + push). Byte-adding PRs queue one at a time against the eager-closure ceiling (objectui#11949, objectui#12007). Dispatches name the whole `scripts/__tests__/` suite. A local Spec Main Shape Gate reproduction needs `TURBO_FORCE=true` and a scratch `--cache-dir`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` takes `objectstack-ai/objectui#N`. A PR body becomes the squash commit message, so a sentence a later push made false is corrected in the body before ready.
- **Sign-off brief `6071794717` read in full at seating;** its carried lessons are the line above.
- **Signed off 2026-10-10T03:21Z:** nothing in flight, nothing accepted and waiting in the queue, no timer left behind.
- **Lessons from this shift:** (1) A `Test` aggregator that reads red on a head a patch push has superseded is its shards reading `cancelled`; read the PR's current `head.sha` and the shard conclusions before acting. (2) Pin a seat body's seating stamp with `{{WAS:…}}` from the second write on; a `{{NOW}}` there re-stamps it on every refresh.
- **Stamp correction:** the seating stamp above is now the seat-take title rename (2026-10-09T07:47Z). Earlier refreshes of this body re-stamped it with each write's own time.
- **Human-merge threshold:** 3,000 changed lines since objectstack `6212cc6c` (#22490).
- **Charter touch since seating:** objectstack `d87dff67` / `587bd969` (read 2026-10-09T11:44Z): the claim template's `Resume-from:` line, the relay's `pr_update_branch` op for base syncs (a bare `update-branch` is ⛔), and triage's reclaim of silent claims.
- **Verification layer:** a merge here reaches users through the published `@object-ui/*` packages; landings are verified on `main` by content and `git patch-id --stable`.
